Rhea: Quick postmortem follow-up / three remediation cards we need owners for. Can ppl claim and add ETAs? :calendar:
Tom: I'll take REMED-4988 (kv-cache eviction tuning + perf tests). Will add acceptance criteria and ETA by EOD Tue.
Ibrahim: Thx Tom. Please include a monthly regression job and the dashboard link.
Tom: Added regression job + dashboard. Acceptance: p95 < 85ms on canary. ETA Tue-2024-06-11.
Sofia: I'll own REMED-4992 (failover runbook + automation). Creating Jira now.
Sofia: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REMED-4992  stub created, draft playbook uploaded. ETA Fri-2024-06-14.
Diego: REMED-5001 (capacity-alert tuning) needs eng-infra change. Eng-infra to own infra patch; Diego will verify post-change.
Rhea: Proposed RACI: REMED-4988 R=Tom A=Ibrahim C=SRE I=Oncall; REMED-4992 R=Sofia A=Rhea C=Platform I=PMs; REMED-5001 R=Eng-Infra A=Diego C=Platform I=Customers. Any objections?
Ibrahim: Looks good. Please tag tickets with "postmortem-action" and add to remediation board.
incident-bot: Reminder: owners must set a Jira due date and acceptance criteria within 48h.
Tom: REMED-4988 updated with perf plan and monthly smoke. Added tag and board link.
Sofia: REMED-4992 runbook includes rollback and staged-canary checklist. ETA Fri-2024-06-14.
Diego: Eng-infra confirmed ownership for REMED-5001 (owner: Luis). Luis will post ETA tomorrow.
Rhea: I'll run weekly remediation syncs until these close, then move to monthly audits for 3 months. I'll send invites. :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim: Also recommend adding a short "recurrence note" to each ticket summarizing the monthly spike history so future owners see the pattern.
Tom: Added recurrence note and linked incident timeline.
incident-bot: Next automated check scheduled 2024-06-15 for REMED-4988/4992/5001.
